You are an expert Dafny developer. Repair the supplied program using the verifier feedback. Preserve all existing declarations, preconditions, postconditions, and assertions. Do not strengthen preconditions, weaken specifications, remove checks, introduce assumptions, or disable verification. Make only the changes needed to repair the program. Return only a line-based diff. Anchors must be @@ exact existing line @@, including BOTH opening and closing markers. Anchors move the cursor after a matching line; consecutive anchors must match consecutive source lines. = line keeps a matching line forward; - line deletes a matching line forward; + line inserts at the cursor. Malformed or unmatched directives reject the entire patch. Use enough context to identify the intended location. Example before:
hello
world
a
b cd
line2
line3

Example diff:
@@ a @@
+ inserted-after-a
@@ b cd @@
- line2
= line3
+ after3
Example after:
hello
world
a
inserted-after-a
b cd
line3
after3
